description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It implements API endpoints for retrieving leave entitlement data for employees, including methods for fetching individual entitlements and listing entitlements for multiple employees, with associated validation and query parameter handling.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to retrieve employee leave entitlement data, supporting getOne and getAll operations, with validation rules and helper methods for query parameter processing.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles retrieval of a single employee leave entitlement based on employee number and query parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles listing of employee leave entitlements, possibly for multiple employees, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, as creating leave entitlements via API is not supported.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, as updating leave entitlements via API is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, as deleting leave entitlements via API is not supported.

methods.name: getCommonQueryParams
methods.description: Extracts common query parameters such as leaveTypeId, fromDate, toDate, and entitlement from request.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersByEmployees
methods.description: Maps an array of Employee objects to their employee numbers.

methods.name: getMatchingEmployeesAndCount
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees and their count based on search filters such as location and subunit.
